Local processing · No account needed
THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Select the question you want to solve and enter two numbers. Percentage change uses the original value as the denominator and is undefined when that original value is zero.

Try this example

15% of 240 is 36. An increase from 80 to 100 is 25%.

Good to know

Can the calculator handle negative values?

Yes. The formulas keep the sign of each value. Percentage changes involving negative starting values may need context to interpret.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
